name: git-glance
description: Git at a glance: a tool that shows the repository's state, a review command, a commit-message skill and a panel.

tools.name: GitGlance
tools.description: Show the git branch of the workspace, its changed files and its latest commits, as JSON.

commits.description: How many recent commits to list; 5 by default.

commands.name: review
commands.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes of this repository: call GitGlance to see what changed, read the diffs, and report problems, most important first. Focus: {{args}}
